notes: Four kinds only. Omission includes qualifiers. Sites use shared disease-compatible groups. Lexical confusion requires the same initial of the literal changed word and selects at least five distinct source-backed core words, ranked by core similarity then whole-answer similarity descending. Search source names and aliases; generate combinations by changing only the disease word in the original answer. The preferred score (0.70) is a quality marker, not a hard cutoff. Report actual scores and below-preferred candidates. Fail explicitly if the terminology cannot supply the requested distinct count. Other categories retain their existing caps and missing entries. Test targets may overlap; never load test predictions.
